description.en: The ID of the backup plan. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to query the ID.

descriptions.zh:
## 影响
释放后，您的备份实例即会停止服务，不再产生费用。
descriptions.en:
## Impact

After you release a backup plan, the service for the backup instance is stopped and you are no longer charged for the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs release-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbstooi01xxxx --client-token dbs --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs ReleaseBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPlanId dbstooi01xxxx --ClientToken dbs
